searchText: Hi guys people always say layer 2 use ethereum layer 1 for security. How does it work exactly? Are there relevant readings? The general idea is that "good behavior" in the L2 can be enforced by contracts on L1 by punishing or making impossible misbehavior The specifics vary dramatically depending on particular designs
